data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Awwa, meaning 'to help'. The name Muizzawi signifies a helper or supporter, one who aids others in their time of need. The name Muizzawi carries the meaning “Assistant or Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muizzawi usually hope their child will grow to embody assistant or helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Muizz li-Din Allah was the fifth caliph of the Fatimid Caliphate, ruling from 1110 to 1130 CE. He is known for his successful military campaigns against the Crusaders and for his patronage of scholars and architects.

The name Muizz li-Din Allah means 'helper of the faith of Allah'. It was a title used by several Islamic rulers throughout history. Another notable ruler with this title was Muizz ud-Din Muhammad Ghurid, who founded the Ghurid Empire in Afghanistan in the late 12th century CE.

Today, this name is widely recognized and celebrated in various modern contexts.
